summary: Surrozen, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events on October 2, 2026, announcing that the FDA cleared its Investigational New Drug (IND) application for SZN-8141, a bifunctional Wnt agonist and VEGF antagonist antibody for diabetic macular edema. This is a routine biotech regulatory milestone and is not a special situation. The IND clearance triggered the second closing milestone under a March 2025 two-tranche private placement, expected to provide approximately $95.1 million in gross proceeds on or about October 20, 2026, subject to closing conditions. The company is expected to dose the first patient in the Phase 1b/2a DUET study in Q4 2026, with initial data anticipated in H2 2027. A resale S-3 registration statement is required within 30 days of closing.
